entries.title: Victoria: An Empire Under the Sun

emulation.notes: Use the Windows PC release with compatibility fixes as needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation for a 2003 grand-strategy game.

primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best-documented and most practical way to play the original Victoria with the Revolutions expansion. The Mac OS X port is valid historically, but Windows PC has the clearer compatibility/capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Victoria: An Empire Under the Sun on Windows PC with the Revolutions expansion or Complete package where available.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Windows PC release with Revolutions/Complete content path.
all_releases.reason: primary: most practical complete and capture route.

all_releases.fidelity: Historic Mac OS X port by Virtual Programming.
all_releases.reason: skip: valid historical route, but Windows PC is the clearer current complete/capture recommendation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC is the best-documented complete route for the base game plus Revolutions.

entries.remaster_caveats: Victoria: Revolutions is expansion content, not a separate mainline entry. Victoria II and Victoria 3 are sequels.

entries.title: Victoria II
entries.definitive_edition: Victoria II on Windows PC with A House Divided and Heart of Darkness

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release with compatibility fixes as needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with A House Divided and Heart of Darkness
primary.why: Windows PC is the original and most practical complete route for Victoria II, with the major expansion path and the strongest compatibility/capture support. The Mac OS X release is valid historically, but Windows PC is the better current recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Play Victoria II on Windows PC through Steam or GOG and add A House Divided plus Heart of Darkness for the full expansion path.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Windows PC release with expansion/DLC path.
all_releases.reason: primary: best complete, compatibility, and capture route.
skip: valid Mac route, but Windows PC is the clearer complete/capture recommendation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC has the clearest current route for the base game plus major expansions.

entries.remaster_caveats: A House Divided and Heart of Darkness are expansions, not separate game entries.

entries.title: Victoria 3
entries.definitive_edition: Victoria 3 on Windows PC with current DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native modern PC presentation with mod/DLC support.

primary.version: Current PC release with DLC library
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original and best Victoria 3 route, with the full DLC/update path, keyboard-and-mouse controls, mod support, and the best capture/settings flexibility. macOS and Linux are valid native routes, but Windows PC remains the safest complete recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, Paradox, Microsoft Store, or GOG and add the DLC packs you want for the current content path.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with the strongest support, DLC, mod, and capture route.
all_releases.reason: primary: best complete and high-fidelity route.
skip: useful native route, but Windows PC remains the preferred support/capture target.
skip: useful native route, but Windows PC remains the preferred support/capture target.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The computer-platform releases share the same content family; Windows PC is the strongest practical capture/support route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Victoria 3's regional/content packs and expansions are DLC, not separate game entries.
